title: How are Microchips Made? 🖥️🛠️ CPU Manufacturing Process Steps
summary: Branch Education walks through a semiconductor fab and the dozens of steps used to turn silicon wafers into microchips, with 3D animation. It covers lithography, deposition and etching at a high level.
why: Pointed to as a clear visual reference for chip manufacturing steps.
